structure.unit: Regulation of Rates for Certain Types of Insurance

law.catch_line: Unfair acts or practices of advisory organization
law.text: If after a hearing the Commission finds that the furnishing of information or assistance by any advisory organization involves any act or practice that is unfair, unreasonable or otherwise inconsistent with this chapter, the Commission may issue a written order (i) specifying in what respects the act or practice is unfair, unreasonable or otherwise inconsistent with this chapter, and (ii) requiring the discontinuance of the act or practice.
